description: List the next review dates for a topic, computed from the day you first studied it with expanding spaced repetition intervals. Dates on or after the exam are marked to skip. Example prompt: "When should I review what I learned today for my exam on 2026-11-30?"

first_study_date.description: The day you first studied it. Defaults to today.

intervals_days.description: Days after the first study to review.

name: next_review_dates
title: Next review dates
